what: An analog clock face for each city that runs on its real time difference. From the base time zone (default UTC+9) plus the offset (lag), every 10ms it rotates the hour hand (hour/12×360 + minute/60×30°), the minute hand (minute/60×360°) and the second hand (if present), and switches the AM/PM text. If the same face has year, month, day and weekday slots, they are filled with the base time zone’s date. A ”what time is it in that city now” face for programs shared by several cities

options.zone: Reference time zone (hours from UTC), default 9
options.lag: Time offset added to the reference, default 0 — City A -9 · City B -16 · City C 2 (original values)
options.every: Redraw interval (ms), default 10 — 60000 with reduced-motion setting
options.[data-fx-part=hour|min|sec]: Hands (direct children) — hour and minute are required, second is optional

note: The original decides AM/PM as ‹PM if the hour is over 12›, so exactly 12:00 is shown as AM — carried over as is. The dial image (60 ticks, thicker every 5th) is drawn as SVG on the consuming side

from.where: index.html .jp-clockPanel .jp-clock (world clock panel on the right of the hero). The original function.js fncSetClock runs on setInterval 10ms, JST based, .timelag -9·-16·2, .edge-clock 160px·60px.
